training.selection_protocol: minimum validation guardrail violation rate, then maximum validation reward; blind test sealed until selection

legacy_policy.replacement_required: site SOP replay and operator dispatch logs

limitations: Regulatory factors are a predeclared engineering stress scenario, not Shanghai inspection telemetry.
The legacy V3 engineering SOP is a transparent proxy, not measured incumbent operator dispatch.
No policy can alter inspection findings, detention, secondary checks or official release decisions.
Site claims require authorized maritime, customs, vessel-call and TOS event replacement plus shadow acceptance.
